annotations.title: Read the fields of a job’s application form

description: Use this when the user wants to apply for a job (Bewerbung) from get_job_matches or list_saved_jobs through the employer’s form. With `ansicht`, instead of asking or linking, call show_application_form as told there. `lesung.felder` lists its fields: `aus_cv` (from the resume), `offen` (ask all at once, numbered; decide what is left) and `nur_pro` (consents and personal characteristics: only the user sets them; never answer them or call them done). With `hintergrundlesung` the app or browser extension reads it in the background: give no link yet; wait `wiederFragenIn` seconds and call again. Without `lesung`, give `leselink` (the app or browser extension reads it and returns to the chat) or else `link`, then call again. `link` opens the filled form to submit: give it only at the end. No link yet with `hinweis`: the user consents only by the tick in show_application_form; never ask or quote it. `zustimmung` means they have: never ask again. With `ohneFormular` there is nothing to fill: tell the user its `satz`, then use its `werkzeug`, or else link the job’s stellenseite. Scope: cv:lesen.

hinweis.description: Set only by the form view’s tick.
